title.suggested: Building Commissioner Condemns Allen's Champion's Rest

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that the building commissioner had condemned the Market Street buildings housing Tom Allen's Champion's Rest and Danny Daly's saloon, dives where fights and robberies were common.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Saturday, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, January 19, 1901, page 5, 'Latest Sport News'.

facts.fact: The building commissioner condemned the buildings on the north side of Market Street between Sixth and Seventh, including Allen's "Champion's Rest" a few doors east of Danny Daly's place, so the saloon keepers had to find new quarters
places: Market Street between Sixth and Seventh, St. Louis
